openings.claim: Weekly membership or renamed identities may explain omissions; reassignment alone is insufficient.
openings.discriminator: Actual exclusion versus present but unrecognized courses.
openings.probe: Compare agreed sets, IDs and CSV rows across fabricated stable, reassigned, renamed and split courses; test isolation and concurrent attendance.
openings.uncertainty: Association is not causation; historical records and fixture intent require verification. Omitted split-center sampling limits safety evidence.

openings.claim: Locate active effort in reconciliation, correction, download or import.
openings.discriminator: Transition-specific checking versus similar import effort; elapsed replacement waiting is separate.
openings.probe: Counterbalance fabricated stable/transition tasks; time stages separately and record intended sets before inspection.
openings.uncertainty: Local reference completeness and real spreadsheet behavior are unmeasured; fabricated tasks may misrepresent field work.

openings.claim: Stable center-scoped identity plus discrepancy-focused weekly reconciliation could drive existing CSV selection; preserve reference provenance and unresolved membership.
openings.discriminator: Identity handles renames; explicit intent handles splits; unresolved and jointly stale references prevent confirmation from proving completeness.
openings.probe: Compare identity-only, reconciliation-only and combined tasks with independent intended sets, stale references, shared omissions and splits; measure accuracy, handling and unresolved outcomes.
openings.uncertainty: Identifiers, historical membership, references and bounded implementation are unverified; do not infer missing history or count unresolved exports as verified usable.

openings.claim: Private export-ready receipts could connect authorized replacement requests to completion-triggered retrieval.
openings.discriminator: Operator-handoff waiting may fall while accuracy and active effort remain unchanged.
openings.probe: Verify exact center/week request-to-CSV binding and completion hooks; time request, waiting and retrieval separately.
openings.uncertainty: Authorization, identifiers, hooks, retries, concurrency and feasibility remain unverified; completion does not prove correct contents.

lineage.reason: Provenance, unresolved decisions and shared omissions retained.

decision: Prioritize diagnostics before choosing implementation. Share six coordinators’ two-session budget; keep names private within authorized workspaces, documented CSV support, concurrent attendance, six engineer-days and existing hosting. Evidence is synthetic; subsequently require next-40 median handling ≤12 minutes, ≥95% intended course sets and zero cross-center records.
